map.💡 综合排序分 = 搜索量 × 权重得分 ÷ 100；首页门槛取搜索量的 90%: 💡 Combined ranking score = search volume × weight score ÷ 100; the first-page threshold is 90% of the search volume; the gap = threshold − ranking score.
map.示例：销量权 0.4 得 80、评分 0.3 得 70、转化 0.3 得 60，: Example: sales weight 0.4 scoring 80, rating 0.3 scoring 70, conversion 0.3 scoring 60, combined = 0.4×80+0.3×70+0.3×60=71.

map.按点击率、转化率、销量、评分与评价数五个因子估算搜索排名竞争力与预估产出。: Estimate search-ranking competitiveness and projected output from five factors: CTR, conversion rate, sales, rating and review count.
map.综合排序分 = Σ(因子指数 × 权重)，权重合计 100 分：CTR 30 /: Combined ranking score = Σ(factor index × weight), weights total 100: CTR 30 / CVR 25 / monthly sales 20 / rating 15 / reviews 10.
map.因子指数 = 实际值 ÷ 基准值，截断到 0–1；基准：CTR 8%、CVR 5: Factor index = actual ÷ benchmark, clamped to 0–1; benchmarks: CTR 8%, CVR 5%, 3000 orders/month, rating 5, 5000 reviews (sales and reviews are log10-normalised).
map.预估点击 = 搜索量 × CTR；预估订单 = 点击 × CVR；预估 GMV: Projected clicks = search volume × CTR; projected orders = clicks × CVR; projected GMV = orders × AOV; gap = threshold score − combined score.
map.五个因子先按基准值归一化，再加权成 0–100 的综合排序分，并据此预估点击、订: The five factors are normalised against benchmarks, weighted into a 0–100 combined score, then used to project clicks, orders and GMV and to locate the weakest factor.
map.这是启发式估算，不是平台真实排序算法：五个因子按公开可观测的基准值归一化后加权，: This is a heuristic estimate, not the platform's real ranking algorithm: the five factors are normalised against observable benchmarks and weighted, for relative comparison within one batch of products and for locating weak factors. Adjust the threshold to your category experience (default 70).
map.该分数为归一化加权启发式估算，与平台真实排序无关；预估点击/订单/GMV 由 C: This score is a normalised weighted heuristic, unrelated to the platform's real ranking; projected clicks/orders/GMV are linearly extrapolated from CTR, CVR and AOV.

Search 220k, CTR 2.2%, CVR 1.1%, AOV CNY 68, rating 4.5, 12,000 reviews, 8,000 orders/month → combined score 57.3, 27.8 points short of the 85 threshold. Sales and reviews already score full marks, but CTR/CVR contribute only 8.3 + 5.5, so for high-traffic keywords improve the main image and detail page for clicks and conversion rather than piling on sales.
map.本工具使用一组公开可解释的经验权重：CTR 30、CVR 25、月销量 20、评: This tool uses a set of public, explainable empirical weights: CTR 30, CVR 25, monthly sales 20, rating 15, reviews 10, totalling 100 points. Platform algorithms are not public, so the score only supports relative comparison within one batch of products and locating weak factors. Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.先按基准值归一化再加权：CTR 8%、CVR 5%、月销 3000 单、评分 5: Factors are normalised against benchmarks — CTR 8%, CVR 5%, 3000 orders/month, rating 5, 5000 reviews — with sales and reviews log10-compressed and values above the benchmark capped at full marks (so endless volume gains nothing). Results are for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation — the platform's official rules and actual accounts prevail.
map.输入月搜索量、CTR、CVR、客单价、评分、评价数与月销量，按公开可解释的经验权: Enter monthly searches, CTR, CVR, average order value, rating, review count and monthly sales; the tool normalizes and weights them with transparent rules of thumb (CTR 30 / CVR 25 / sales 20 / rating 15 / reviews 10) into a 0–100 ranking score, then reports the gap to your first-page threshold, projected clicks / orders / GMV and the weakest factor.
map.五因子按基准归一化后加权，避免量纲差异: Five factors normalized to benchmarks before weighting, so different units are comparable
map.自动标出最短板因子与得分 / 满分: Highlights the weakest factor with its score / maximum
map.由 CTR、CVR、客单价线性外推点击、订单与 GMV: Extrapolates clicks, orders and GMV linearly from CTR, CVR and average order value
map.计算历史保存在本地，可一键恢复上次参数: Calculation history is stored locally and the last inputs can be restored in one click
map.同一类目内多款商品的相对竞争力比较: Compare the relative competitiveness of multiple listings in one category
map.定位 CTR / CVR / 评分中的最短板: Find the weakest of CTR / CVR / rating
